subject: Post-call recap & mutual commitments timeline (NovaCare)
body:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novacare.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap & mutual commitments timeline (NovaCare)

Hi Olivia / Samir —

Great to speak with you both earlier. Quick recap of what we covered and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) to keep momentum. Please flag anything I missed or dates that won't work.

Key pain & goals you shared
- Latency on patient-facing triage model is inconsistent under peak traffic (1.5–2.5s currently; goal <400ms).
- Cost per inference is higher than desired for high-volume endpoints (target: ~40% reduction).
- Need for strict auditability and VPC isolation for PHI-sensitive flows.

What success looks like
- Realtime triage model at <400ms 95th percentile for peak loads
- 40% reduction in per-token inference cost via batching + quantization profiles
- Private deployment option with KMS + audit logs integration for SOC2 audit next H1

Proposed mutual commitments (first-pass milestones)
1) Technical deep-dive + sample load test (Redwood + NovaCare infra) — target: 2026-11-12
   - Owners: Karthik (Redwood PM), Olivia (NovaCare Eng lead)
   - Deliverable: run of 100 rps synthetic triage workload, latency/cost report

2) Security & compliance packet + architecture review (VPC/KMS) — target: 2026-11-19
   - Owners: Lauren (Redwood Security), Samir (NovaCare SecOps)
   - Deliverable: integration checklist and IAM flow diagram

3) Pilot configuration & pricing proposal (2-week pilot) — target: sign by 2026-11-26
   - Owners: Ben (Redwood Sales), procurement@novacare.com
   - Deliverable: pilot SOW, pricing, pilot acceptance criteria

4) Exec review & decision (PO / purchase) — target: 2026-12-10
   - Owners: Olivia (Sponsor), NovaCare Procurement

Attachments: Draft MAP workbook and SOW stub attached for your review.

Next steps for this week
- Olivia: confirm 11/12 for the load test window (morning PT preferred)
- Samir: share any existing load scripts or top-talk models we should mirror
- I will send a one-page security checklist to Samir and loop Lauren for the architecture review

Thanks again — excited to move this forward.

Best,

Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com] | +1 (415) 555-0184

[Attachment: NovaCare_MPA_v1.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 42KB)]

--- Original message ---
From: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novacare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Intro call — triage model performance

Thanks Karthik — this aligns with my notes. A few clarifications: we have an internal compliance review on 2026-12-01 that will require the audit logs for any pilot handling PHI, and procurement will need 10 business days after the SOW to issue a PO. I can make 11/12 work for the load test (10:00am PT).

Also looping Samir (SecOps) and procurement so they see the milestones.

Olivia Turner
Director of Product, NovaCare Health
olivia.turner@novacare.com

> On Nov 2, 2026, at 15:12, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Great to speak with you both earlier. Quick recap...

--- Reply (11/03/2026 09:08) ---
From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacare.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novacare.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:08:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & mutual commitments timeline (NovaCare)

Karthik — thanks for the clear plan. A couple of items from SecOps:
- We will need proof of key rotation policies and HSM/KMS vendor compatibility (we run AWS KMS + internal HSM).
- Can you confirm data-at-rest and in-transit encryption details for a Private deployment?

I'll prep a short list of required artifacts and attach it here. Also, procurement@novacare.com is copied — they will confirm internal PO timelines once we provide the SOW.

Regards,
Samir
Security Operations Manager, NovaCare
[Attachment: NovaCare_sec_requirements.docx (Word doc, 18KB)]

--- Reply (11/04/2026 10:42) ---
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@novacare.com>, Olivia Turner <olivia.turner@novacare.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & mutual commitments timeline (NovaCare)

Samir / Olivia —

Thanks for the quick responses and the security notes, Samir. Lauren — looped you to handle the architecture checklist and confirm KMS/HSM compatibility. Ben — heads-up that procurement will likely ask for a 10-day review window once we send the SOW.

I attached a filled-in MAP workbook with explicit owners and dates (v1). I also pushed a short SOW draft for the pilot (2 weeks, non-production, standard data handling with optional VPC). Please review and let me know if we should soften the billing terms for procurement.

Lauren — can you confirm by EOD 11/05 whether the KMS/HSM items below are covered and whether there are any red flags for private deployment in our standard package?

Thanks,
Karthik

[Attachment: Redwood_SOW_Draft.pdf (PDF, 28KB)]

--- Internal note (11/05/2026 09:22) ---
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & mutual commitments timeline (NovaCare)

Karthik / Ben —

Quick internal check: I reviewed the security ask. Redwood standard private package supports AWS KMS and common HSM flows (we've done similar with two enterprise healthcare customers). The SOW draft references audit log retention and KMS integration; I'll add a short appendix listing rotation intervals, key alias patterns, and where audit logs are surfaced. No immediate red flags, but if NovaCare insists on on-prem HSM appliance we may need legal/infra sign-off and a small integration fee.

Ben — if procurement pushes on price because of the compliance appendix, we should be prepared to offer a one-time $12k integration credit to keep the pilot on schedule. If you agree, I'll add that to the negotiation notes.

Lauren Bishop
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com

[End of thread]
